title: Sheaf scalar extension preserves monomorphisms over a field
statement: For a field k, a topological space X, a sheaf R of rings and alpha:k -> R(X), the scalar-extension functor [def-sc-field-scalar-extension] preserves monomorphisms. The module universe is Type(max u v). No commutativity of R or centrality of alpha is needed.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Tags 0095 and 0096; Modules, Tag 02N4. Canonical online tag pages consulted; noncommutative presheaf construction and universe bookkeeping made explicit by M2.

proof.text: The inclusion of sheaves into presheaves preserves monomorphisms. Conversion to constant-ring modules [def-sc-module-presheaf-constant-modules] preserves monomorphisms because f_U is monic in ModuleCat k at every U, hence injective, and the converted morphism has the same component functions. Apply PresheafOfModules.mono_of_injective.

proof.text: Presheaf scalar extension preserves monomorphisms by [lem-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-pullback-mono]. Module sheafification preserves finite limits in Mathlib, hence preserves monomorphisms. Install the larger-universe sheafification instances proved with [def-sc-field-scalar-extension] and compose these preservation instances.
